sources.title: CLI - Codex | OpenAI Developers
sources.snippet: The codex sdk exposes lower-level access for teams building custom tooling on top of the same stack. References to chatgpt/codex, open ai codex, and codex open ai in search queries all point to this same ecosystem; Codex CLI is the command-line entry point into it.

sources.title: TheBloke/Open_Gpt4_8x7B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Open Gpt4 8X7B - GGUF Model creator: rombo dawg Original model: Open Gpt4 8X7B Description This repo contains GGUF format model files for rombo dawg's Open Gpt4 8X7B. These files were quantised using hardware kindly provided by Massed Compute. About GGUF GGUF is a new format introduced by the llama.cpp team on August 21st 2023.

sources.title: GPT-4 | OpenAI
sources.snippet: GPT‑4‑assisted safety research GPT‑4's advanced reasoning and instruction-following capabilities expedited our safety work. We used GPT‑4 to help create training data for model fine-tuning and iterate on classifiers across training, evaluations, and monitoring.
